snippet.title: Prism of You - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Prism of You - play for free now on Steam!

Prism of You is an emergent sandbox simulator where players interact with quirky creatures known as Emoes that represent human emotions. 

Explore the tumultuous inner world of the Prism, a safe space to engage with the ups and downs of emotional extremes and everything in between. In this systems focused game, players experiment with unique mechanics in a quest to achieve emotional harmony. 

Identify Emoes to influence their state through various forms of Engagement – like duplicating, feeding, and evolving – and Express pent up emotional charge in your Emoes by channeling their energy through a cathartic thought. Players can also take self-care actions to aid in managing their Prism and uncover thought-provoking lore about the Prism’s origins as they progress. 

This simulator is unique in that resource balance, not maximization, is the goal, where players are motivated intrinsically by emergent gameplay and experimentation. Everyone’s Prism is different - what will yours look like?

Find out by downloading Prism of You on Steam!
